body: Looks like this came up when the pipeline was being implemented: https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/main/packages/compiler/src/template/pipeline/src/ingest.ts#L729.

IIRC this is not a regression -- in fact, we deliberately reimplemented this bug in Template Pipeline to avoid breaking applications. Now that `TemplateDefinitionBuilder` is deleted, it might be time to try fixing this for good, and get a sense of how breaking that change would be.

issue.body:
Consider a template with a context variable `a`:
```
<ng-template let-a>{{this.a}}</ng-template>
```

An interpolation inside that template to `this.a` should intuitively read the class variable `a`. However, today, it refers to the context variable `a`, both in the TCB and the generated code.

In this commit, the above interpolation now refers to the class field `a`.

Fixes #55115
